lead_raw_text:
The structure of K2ZrBi2 crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I4/mmm (No. 119), with a unit cell containing 10 atoms (K4 Zr2 Bi4) distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Bi centers with 16 geometric neighbors (8 K, 4 Bi, 4 Zr), K centers with 10 neighbors (4 Bi, 6 K), and Zr centers with 8 Bi neighbors, all forming a single three-dimensional connectivity component. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner, edge, and face sharing between K and Zr coordination polyhedra, and corner and edge sharing between Bi and Zr polyhedra.
